latest_release.name: PHPMailer 7.2.0
latest_release.body:
# PHPMailer 7.2.0

* XOAUTH authentication with long tokens could report success when it had failed.
* S/MIME signed messages no longer contain bare LF line breaks.
* `PHPMailer::parseAddresses()` is deprecated, and will be removed in 8.0; it's too difficult to maintain consistently with the removal of the PHP IMAP extension, and it is the only part of PHPMailer that handles existing messages.
* The `pcre8` validation pattern is deprecated. The default PHP validator is fine, and the pattern has some distant possibilities for ReDoS problems, so it's going.
* Long address lines are now folded correctly.
* Don't send `QUIT` if the connection is closed while `DATA` is in progress. Thanks to @dualfroz.
* XCLIENT commands should expect a 220 response, not 250, and reset to a pre-HELO state.
* XCLIENT properties are now expected to be raw values, and are `xtext`-encoded at send time. Strictly speaking this is a BC break, but the above issue meant that XCLIENT was broken anyway, so the break is academic.
* Switch tests to use [BadSMTP](https://badsmtp.com) instead of postfix's smtp-sink for more reliable CI.
* Enable PHP 8.7 in CI, don't allow PHP 8.6 to fail any more.

## What's Changed
* Clarify Gmail app password usage in Gmail SMTP example by @Safaa-Raboudi in https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/pull/3340
* Add missing French translations by @Safaa-Raboudi in https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/pull/3341
* Fix smtps DSN encryption mode by @Shushangw in https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/pull/3345
* GH Actions: fail "setup-php" if requested tooling could not be installed by @jrfnl in https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/pull/3355
* Normalise line breaks in S/MIME signed messages by @dualfroz in https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/pull/3358
* Fold long address headers by @dualfroz in https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/pull/3361
* Don't send QUIT while DATA is in progress by @dualfroz in https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/pull/3362
* Composer: allow for PHPCS 4.x by @jrfnl in https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/pull/3372
* GH Actions: update for the upcoming release of PHP 8.6 by @jrfnl in https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/pull/3373

## New Contributors
* @Safaa-Raboudi made their first contribution in https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/pull/3340
* @Shushangw made their first contribution in https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/pull/3345
* @dualfroz made their first contribution in https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/pull/3358

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/compare/v7.1.1...v7.2.0
